description: Retrieve the admin URL for a document previously uploaded via this MCP server. The admin URL grants full control and is equivalent to a password. ONLY call this tool when the user explicitly asks to see, save, or copy the admin URL — for example: 'give me the admin URL', 'save the admin link to my notes', 'what's the owner credential'. DO NOT call this as part of normal upload, share, or collaboration flows; the admin URL should never be surfaced to the user unless directly requested.

document_id.description: Document ID (from upload_markdown response or list_my_documents)

name: get_admin_url
